title: The study guide asks for your login
scenario: A classmate posts a “professor-approved” study guide in the group chat. The link asks you to sign in with your university account and approve access to your files and contacts.

answers.A: Ask for the file through the university’s normal drive/LMS and do not approve broad access.
answers.B: Verify with the classmate or professor through another channel before connecting your account.
answers.C: Approve it because the classmate is real and everyone needs the guide for the exam.

explanation: The classmate’s account may be compromised, and broad OAuth access is unnecessary for a simple document.
proTip: A study guide should not need your inbox or contacts.
